applies_to: ioLogik R1210 per the ioLogik R1200 Series User's Manual, Edition 3.4 (April 2021).
summary: The ioLogik R1210 is a Moxa RS-485 Modbus RTU remote I/O module with 16 digital inputs (each usable as a counter). It supports a repeater or dual RS-485 mode and a Modbus host-connection watchdog with safe-mode output states. This map covers the shared system registers (model, watchdog, serial settings) and the 16 DI / counter channels.

addressing.note: Each row prints the hex protocol address and a 1-based reference number (0x0000 = 00001/10001/30001/40001). The hex address is sent on the wire; the table (coil, discrete input, input or holding) is set by the function code column.

source.title: ioLogik R1200 Series User's Manual
source.pages: pp. 2-4 to 2-5 (device ID, serial settings, Initial/Run and Dual/Repeater switches), Appendix A pp. A-2 to A-37 (Modbus mapping), Appendix B (factory defaults)

notes: Moxa does not appear to offer this manual on a public URL found in this pass; the link is an unaltered copy of the Moxa user's manual on a reseller's file host.
Each table row gives the hex wire address, the 1-based decimal reference (e.g. 0x0000 = 40001; system registers use six digits, 0x7530 = 330001), access, size and function code.
32-bit counters are listed as ...High and ...Low word registers with the high word at the lower address; they are combined here as UINT32 high word first (ABCD).
Left out: system strings and multi-word values whose format is not described (firmware version and release date, serial number, server name/location, password, vendor name).

integration.summary: Poll the I/O block with the function code shown for each register (01/02 for bits, 03/04 for words). Enable the Modbus watchdog (0x7564, timeout 0x7565) so outputs and counters fall back to their safe-mode settings if the master stops polling.
integration.enable: Set the device ID (1-99) on the two rotary dials. Put the Initial/Run switch on Initial to configure the unit at 9600 baud, no parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit (with ioSearch or the SYS_port* registers), then switch back to Run.
integration.watchdog: SYS_modbusWatchdogFuntion (0x7564) enables the host-connection watchdog, SYS_modbusWatchdogTimeout (0x7565) sets the timeout in seconds (factory default 10 s), SYS_modbusWatchdogStatus (0x7566) shows a timeout. It is disabled by default; safe-status settings only act when it is enabled.
quirks: System registers sit at 0x7530 and up (six-digit references 330001/430002).
Write 404 to SYS_restartDevice or SYS_loadFactoryDefault to trigger them.
setup: Device ID 1-99 on the rotary dials (x1 and x10).
The Dual/Rep switch selects two separate RS-485 ports or repeater mode; SYS_rs485PortMode reports which is active.
gotchas: Factory defaults (reset button held 5 s, ioSearch, or SYS_loadFactoryDefault) return the serial settings to 9600 n 8 1 and disable the watchdog.
